Note the time taken for the two layers to separate out. Similarly take the bottles C, D and E and note the time taken for the separation of two layers in each case and record the observations.
From the observations it is clear that mustard oil takes longest time to get separated from its emulsion and kerosene oil takes minimum time.
The decreasing order of stability or effectiveness is: Mustard oil > Coconut oil > Cotton seed oil > Castor oil > Kerosene oil.
